propositions: Jira-specific probe logic (REST URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) is co-located with backend-neutral vocabulary in inbound_probe.py, blocking addition of a second backend and violating epic bbf1 AC3 (zero adapters.jira imports in core)

The neutral probe result vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain at package root per ADR 0035 location pinning and filename-based loading, while Jira mechanics move to adapters/jira/probe.py
run_differs.py calls probe directly without routing through a capability-aware backend interface, preventing capability-based dispatch and fallback to UNREACHABLE for backends lacking probe support

A runtime_checkable SupportsAbsenceProbe capability Protocol is needed in _backend.py with probe_remote(remote_id: str) method to enable vendor-agnostic probe routing and allow backends to opt in or degrade gracefully
